instruction: The starter part part_with_vise.step is already loaded. Set the two vise jaws in C:\Users\User\Desktop\part_with_vise.step as fixture or avoidance geometry. Machine the two top pockets using iMachining or Pocket toolpaths while maintaining at least 3 mm clearance from the fixtures on all low-level toolpath points. Tool definition: T1 is an 8 mm end mill for the two top pockets. Save the required output file(s) to the Desktop: C:\Users\User\Desktop\task-11.nc.
